findings.evidence: .agents/skills/milestone-review/SKILL.md reads '-> scripts/check-milestone-handoff.sh'. That script's header states that the bare invocation's window is zero commits wide and that no commit in this repository's history has ever been in the state it inspects. `grep -ln check-milestone-review.sh scripts/gates/*.sh` returns all nine completion gates; `grep -ln check-milestone-handoff.sh scripts/gates/*.sh` returns one, m4-complete.sh, leg 0b. Leg 0 propagated to every gate as a convention; leg 0b exists once and the convention is written nowhere -- not in SKILL.md, not in sdd.md, not in the roadmap. If m5-complete.sh does not copy it, M6.0 flips M5's cell and dissolves its rows in the same commit and M5 closes with rows stranded, which M4.79's zero-width window means no gate can catch. Recorded as a rule-15 minor in 5c2610f's body and filed here as the row that body said the next commit would open. DISPOSITION (2) hands it to M5: m4-complete.sh carries the leg today, so no gate of M4's is unable to fail.
findings.summary: The milestone-review procedure still points at the bare check-milestone-handoff.sh, which its own header documents as unable to fail, and nothing records that a completion gate must carry the --milestone leg.

findings.evidence: scripts/lib.sh's milestone_commits excludes a commit only when every changed path matches '^reviews/milestone-.*\.json$'. milestone-review/SKILL.md requires the backlog row to exist before a finding cites it, and record validates task_id against open_task_ids, so the closing round's commit necessarily carries backlog.md and is enumerated, uncovered, and fails check-milestone-review.sh --milestone -- which is leg 0 of every completion gate. Measured across history: the last review artifact of every completed milestone was added by a commit touching exactly one file -- M-1 1256598, M0 fdd5bae, M1 bd5d134, M2 7002926, M3 5849ecc, M9 c7edb35, M10 6bf1602, M11 0cddf67, and M4's own d2db096 ('M4.41: record the terminating round's verdict', 1 file changed). Nine instances of a move no skill names: `grep -rni 'addendum|verdict-only' .agents/skills/` returns only the line stating the mechanic, which never says the closing round must be recorded alone, nor that it must therefore produce zero blocking or major findings. M4.73's disposition rule tightened this and did not mention it. DISPOSITION (2) hands it to M5: no gate is unable to fail -- the gate fails correctly, and it is the documented procedure that has no reachable terminating state.
findings.summary: A boundary round that files rows can never be the last one: milestone_commits enumerates any commit touching more than reviews/, so every one of the nine closings so far needed an undocumented verdict-only commit, and no skill names the move or its precondition.
